Short answers to Leah’s asks (preview for Nora):
- Dedicated SLA one-pager: included; TL;DR: we commit to 99.9% availability on reserved pools with documented latency percentiles for standard payloads, and a documented escalation path for MTTR. Full contract details are part of the Dedicated agreement (we’ll share the SOC2/audit artifacts as part of the security pack).
- KV cache persistence: the KV cache is persisted per model session and can be configured to persist for warm-starts across pre-warmed workers; for strict data controls we run cache in customer-isolated VPC subnets on Dedicated. Ben will cover technical details in the walkthrough.
